Plus a governance-organ design thread (handoff at [repo-root]/development/authority-triage/development/handoffs/2026-06-29-governance-organs-via-triage.md): reify minted governances as organs = authority-triage (route) + methods + constitution slice; open fork lane-vs-spell → decision-gate. Next = sigil-development applies L1-L4, then the deferred N=3 falsification experiment run.
Define the call contract to domainspec-new-repo (--source, --attach submodule, dry-run) as Mint stage 1.
Specify the authority-spine seed contract (what kinds/policy/constitution a mint emits) — the plan's load-bearing slice.
Reverse-engineer the resonantos authority artifacts into the Mint emit-template set.
Decide whether adopt-back is in Mint's MVP scope or a deferred follow-on route.
Resolve against BLK-CAV2-PUBLIC-PRIVATE-001 before a mint can emit a public-attached repo.
Template the crosswalk emit from the resonantos as-built example.

DomainSpec v2 live state remains owned by projects/domainspec-v2/.craft/ledger.yml. The 2026-07-23 BTE bootstrap refresh is applied: the L0A/L0B-L8 package is validated and SWU-BTE-L0A-001 is the sole dependency-ready, unselected candidate. It publishes contracts before the independent freeze gates L0B. UI remains independent; IOLM and Body War consumer execution waits for the shared core.

Preserve the historical A1-A4 evidence and execute one fresh A1 rebind against the selected current Key-and-Door fixture generation; keep A2-A4 gated until fresh predecessor receipts pass. Separately, 00C-B remains selected and blocked pending upstream cross-feature support, 00C-C remains unselected, and GATE-CAV2-IOLM-SG-001 remains open for later authoritative rebind.

Build a strict Context Pack and compact Goal for one SWU-IOLM-00C-UI-A1 rebind; recheck the exact Key-and-Door hashes immediately before mutation, write only the A1 subset plus a new rebind lifecycle, and stop at a fresh iolm-fixture-boundary/v1.
